messages:
PagerDuty Bot: [P1] Alert: GPU pool 'render-gpu-pool' queue length > 95th pct and autoscaler hit hard cap. Multiple XID/OOM events observed. PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.example/incident/1789990000
Maya (oncall): I'm paged — jumping in. Queue backlog ~3.1k requests, tail latency > 20s. Seeing increased kernel XID reports in driver logs. Starting triage.
Tom (sre): Confirming XID/OOM noise on nodes gpu-n-3, gpu-n-7, gpu-n-12. Autoscaler logs: "reached_max_capacity: 40". Cloud quota shows pool hard limit.
Ana (prod): Product impact: imagegen-pro and embed-search customers seeing 5xx/timeouts. Approx 2.1% global error rate; for a few high-volume tenants it's ~8%. CS already flagged 2 enterprise customers.
Ryan (infra): Quota check: project GPU quota is at 100% — staging has ~8 reserved nodes that look inactive. I'll try to preempt staging tasks.
Maya (oncall): Immediate mitigations I want to try: reduce concurrency for heavy routes, throttle batch/jit jobs, restart drivers on the flapping nodes, and shift some traffic to lighter model variants or cpu-fallback for non-SLA routes.
Tom (sre): Agreed. Plan (short):
  1) Apply route-level throttles to reduce incoming work.
  2) Cordon + restart driver on worst nodes, drain long-running sessions.
  3) Free up staging GPUs to let autoscaler request more.
  4) If needed, failover some traffic to 'redwood-lite' model.
Ryan (infra): I'm reclaiming staging now. Tagged jobs and sending stop requests.
InfraBot: metric snapshot (promql):
  queue_size_over_time{pool="render-gpu-pool"} = 3120
  node_xid_rate{job="gpu-driver",node=~"gpu-n-.*"} = 0.87
  autoscaler_scale_failures_total{reason="quota_limit"} = 28
Maya (oncall): Running cordon + restart on gpu-n-3 and gpu-n-7 now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-n-3 -n gpu-serving
kubectl drain gpu-n-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n gpu-serving
ssh root@gpu-n-3 'systemctl restart nvidia-driver || systemctl restart nvidia-host'
```
Tom (sre): While nodes restart, reduce concurrency for heavy routes (control-plane):
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/routes/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate/imagegen-pro","max_concurrency":1}'
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/routes/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings/search","max_concurrency":1}'
```
Ana (prod): I've opened a short status note for CS and support: "Investigating GPU pool backlog; temporary latency degradation for some customers. ETA for next update: 15m." Also sending 1:1 to affected enterprise accounts.
InfraBot: Action logs: cordon gpu-n-3 -> success; restart attempt -> systemd OK; node rejoin in 45s. Logs show reduced XID occurrences after restart.
Maya (oncall): gpu-n-3 is back and marked ready. Observed kernel lines: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID 8421" decreased afterwards.
Ryan (infra): Staging freed 8 nodes. Autoscaler attempted scale again and requested +6 nodes; cloud accepted 2 pending more because billing quota throttled burst. Raising emergency quota with cloud support.
Tom (sre): Temporary routing fallback deployed for non-critical customers to 'redwood-lite' (lower-cost variant). This shaves ~30% of GPU load.
Maya (oncall): Queue dropped from 3.1k -> 900 within 7m of these mitigations. Tail latency improving. Still watching XID chatter, but error rate down to 0.6%.
Ana (prod): Customer impact summary for post-incident update: "Intermittent timeouts and increased latencies for imagegen-pro and embed-search between 17:04–17:19 UTC. Mitigated by route throttles, driver restarts, and temporary routing fallbacks. Enterprise CS notified."
Tom (sre): Root-cause hypothesis so far: a combination of driver/kernel-level memory pressure causing recurring XID/OOMs and a conservatively configured autoscaler quota that prevented emergency burst capacity. Also lack of automatic staging preemption.
Maya (oncall): Follow-ups (action items):
  - Create postmortem with timeline and logs (owner: Maya).
  - Autoscaler: add emergency burst policy + preemption of non-prod (owner: Ryan).
  - Driver healthchecks: implement automated cordon-and-restart when XID rate > threshold (owner: Tom).
  - Ramp up driver stress tests in CI to reproduce leak (owner: Eng-ML).
Ana (prod): I'll draft customer-facing postmortem and coordinate with CS.
InfraBot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update scheduled in 30m.
Maya (oncall): Closing pager for now; will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks all for quick work. :thumbsup:
